thread:
lucy: Heads-up — during the canary we saw an uptick in schema rejections for fncall responses routed to eu-west dedicated. Mostly payment-tool replies returning arrays instead of expected objects. anyone else seeing this?

maya: seeing it. Reject rate ~0.9% on the last hour sample. Console shows a clear spike in the validate.fncall category.

tj: is this tied to the strict-validator flip? I thought soft-validate was still on for canary slice.

lucy: we toggled strict-validate for the canary slice to vet the new parser. The odd part: fallback router is sending traffic to the degen variant which itself returns a slightly different tool payload shape — so it looks like a double hit (validate rejects, then fallback still produces unexpected shape).

kevin: can you paste a quick query? I want to confirm tool_name distribution. try: `SELECT tool_name, count(*) FROM telemetry.events WHERE event='fncall.reject' AND region='eu-west' GROUP BY tool_name;`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout of strict-validate v2 started — rollout_id=rl_20250912_1412 — monitoring enabled.

ahmed: console recommendation: add a breadcrumb in the invocation timeline that records "validator:error:reason" + route_id + validator_version. Right now we just get a generic reject event and it's hard to trace whether the fallback preserved or altered shape.

maya: also needs quota/billing clarity — some of these rejects are being billed as model tokens even though they never reached the tool. we should surface whether a reject consumed tool tokens vs model tokens in the per-request breakdown.

tj: propose immediate action: 1) flip strict-validate back for the canary (rollback), 2) enable rejection sampling capture (redact PII) so we can inspect raw payloads, 3) add a dashboard panel for reject_reason x route_id x validator_version.

lucy: +1 to that plan. @eng-ml and @eng-platform can you own sampling + redaction? Keven, can you add the dashboard card and tag by route? low-effort visual will help triage.

kevin: I'll add a "fncall reject breakdown" card that shows reject_reason, route_id, validator_version, and sample_count. ETA ~2h. I'll wire an alert if reject_rate > 0.5% for more than 15m in any region.

ops-bot: incident created — #inc-1788004321 — tracking rollback + sampling capture tasks.

lucy: thanks. after we collect samples for 2h, we can decide if validator rules need to be loosened or if adapter needs a patch. also follow up: make fallback variant's output contract explicit in console so rollouts can't silently change tool shapes.

ahmed: noted — I'll draft a console UX spec for a "fallback contract" breadcrumb and small schema diff visual.

maya: leaving a note to audit billing attribution once we have samples. could be a surprise chargeback for customers if we count rejects incorrectly.

tj: LGTM. doing rollback now.

lucy: rolling back and enabling sampling. ping here once dashboard is up. :thumbsup:
